description: Use when someone asks how high to hang a picture, a print, a mirror or art, on an open wall or above a sofa, bed or sideboard. Returns the hook’s height from the floor and checks the art’s width against the furniture.

centre_height_cm.description: On an open wall, the picture’s centre height (default 145, the gallery height; 150 also common) (cm).

furniture_gap_cm.description: Over furniture: the gap from its top to the frame (designers use 15–25 cm) (cm).

furniture_height_cm.description: Over furniture: the furniture’s top, from the floor (cm).

furniture_width_cm.description: Over furniture: its width, to check the art is about two thirds of it (cm).

hanger_drop_cm.description: The hanger drop: from the frame’s top edge down to the wire pulled tight, or to the D-ring (cm).

place.description: open_wall, or over_furniture (a sofa, bed or sideboard).

name: picture_height

ideal_width_cm.description: Over furniture: two thirds of its width

width_share.description: Over furniture: the frame’s width ÷ the furniture’s
